title: growth-brain tick still runs growth:sync_cadence in the foreground under a fixed timeout (Hermes cron config, outside the repo)
evidence: Remaining half of growth-tick-kills-its-own-render (closed 2026-09-19): the repo side is fixed -- ReconcileStaleRuns bounds abandoned sync runs and Growth::RenderSalvage now recovers the renders themselves -- but the producer is still SIGKILLed by the tick's foreground budget (a ~45 min 5-render shortfall inside a 180s tool budget). tc-growth-harness-brain lives in ~/.hermes/profiles/turbo-carnival/cron/jobs.json, which is outside this repo, so it is filed rather than edited. Cheapest fix: run growth:sync_cadence detached (direct >> log 2>&1 &) and let the next tick's render_need top up what is missing -- sync_cadence counts existing posts, so a partial run is safe to resume; or split into per-slot batches; or raise the tick's tool timeout above the measured ~45 min worst case. Needs Tim's ok (cron config + spend behaviour).
